lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: The air down here is freezing... Where on earth are we?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Welcome to the Sunken Labyrinth, young traveler. Few who step into these depths ever see daylight again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: These corridors look endless. It feels like the walls themselves are shifting...

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Your senses do not deceive you. The stone remembers every lost soul trapped in its corridors.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Keep your blade drawn, mark your path, and beware the shadows lurking around every corner.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: No turning back now. Let's find the way through.
